# Research interface — compatibility fixture vault

The vault every branch that touches `bin/lib_research.py`, `bin/lib_vault.py`, `bin/knowledge-reindex.py` or `bin/mnemon-search.py` must read the same way (docs/specs/2026-10-27-research-interface.md §11). `Sources/` holds five legacy revisions (one bookmark-tier, one superseded pair, one captured without an extract); `Synthesis/` one stable and one seed note; `Collections/` one valid open dossier with every accepted line form, a minimal `inbox` one, a `closed` one with the veto fields, and four documents that must fail: every rejected line form, a duplicate `## Items`, a broken frontmatter, a missing `## Items`. The expected readings live next to it in `../expected/` and are compared by `tests/test_research.sh` (`tests/fixtures/research/generate.sh --check`; `--write` regenerates them after a deliberate contract change, which is a spec change in the same PR).
